amount-hero.purpose: The one large ink number per screen.

appearance.note: Every theme colour is a DynamicColorIOS light/dark pair; resolve with useResolve() where a plain string is needed (SVG). Stamp colours are not paired.

stampAssignment.rule: Member id hashes (x31) to a stamp colour so a person keeps it across groups; on a clash within one group the later joiner takes the next free colour.

shadows.name: float

motion.name: postmark-land

motion.name: press

narrative.overview:
Every member of a group is a postage stamp, and every finished payment is cancelled with a postmark. The app is a white card (near-black in dark mode) on which ink-black type and controls do all the work; the only colour comes from two places: the stamps that identify people, and the blue-violet postmark ink that marks something done. The story the system tells is the life of a group: stamps gather, balances show their length, payments get cancelled one by one, until the group itself is postmarked "Settled".

The world refuses the category default of a grey list with one accent colour and the dark-fintech look (near-black, single neon accent, tracked mono labels, everything boxed in cards). Hierarchy comes from scale, not boxes: one large ink amount per screen, compact rows on the page ground with inset hairlines, one right-hand money column. It is a native iOS app first: native-shaped navigation bar, segmented control, page sheets, SF Pro with Dynamic Type, every colour a light/dark pair that follows the system appearance.
keyCharacteristics: Ink is the interactive colour; there is no accent tint.
Stamp colour is identity only, assigned per person.
No card containers: plain lists with inset hairlines; inset grouped lists only in Settings.
One large Archivo Narrow amount per screen; all money in tabular figures on a single right column.
The postmark is the system's only celebratory device, and it lands with a press-down.

rules.name: The Ink Is The Accent Rule
rules.body: Every control is ink on white or white on ink. No coloured buttons, no tinted links; if something needs to be tapped, it is ink.

rules.name: The Stamp Is Identity Rule
rules.body: A stamp colour belongs to one person in a group. It may fill their stamp and their balance bar; it never decorates a button, header, chart or background.

rules.name: The One Big Number Rule
rules.body: Each screen has at most one amount set in amount-hero ink: your balance in the group, your overall position, or the amount being entered. Everything else ranks below it.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Section headers, day labels and captions are sentence-case SF Pro. Uppercase appears only inside the postmark's own lettering and on the invite code, which is a code, not a label.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: All money is Archivo Narrow with tabular figures so columns of cents line up.

rules.name: The No Boxes Rule
rules.body: Content sits on the page ground as plain lists with hairlines inset to the text column. The inset grouped list (`Group`, surface grey, 12 radius) is for settings-shaped content only, and Settings is where it lives.

rules.name: The Only Floaters Cast Rule
rules.body: If it does not float above the screen, it has no shadow. Rows, fields, buttons and sections are flat.

rules.name: The Earned Postmark Rule
rules.body: A postmark appears only on something that is actually finished: a paid payment or a settled group. It is never decoration, an empty-state ornament or a badge for anything else.

dos: **Do** make every control ink: primary buttons ink-filled, secondary ink-outlined (1.5), links ink text.
**Do** colour a person only through their stamp and balance bar, using `assignStampColors` so they keep the same colour across groups.
**Do** set all money in Archivo Narrow with tabular figures, in one right-hand column, and give each screen at most one amount-hero number.
**Do** leave UI text on the system font (no `fontFamily`) so Dynamic Type and CJK fallback work.
**Do** define new colours as `DynamicColorIOS` light/dark pairs in `theme.ts`, and resolve them with `useResolve()` for SVG.
**Do** use cancel lines when the row text already says "paid"; use the full postmark when the mark is the message.
donts: **Don't** use tracked uppercase mono labels or eyebrows above titles; section headers are sentence case.
**Don't** introduce an accent-coloured button or tinted link; ink is the interactive colour.
**Don't** box content in cards; use plain lists with inset hairlines, and keep inset grouped lists to Settings.
**Don't** put shadows on anything that does not float.
**Don't** use a stamp colour, or postmark blue, as decoration.
